name: Ishizuki Naoji
source:
Star Sign: Capricorn
Hobby: Flute, Reading, Poetry
Special Skill: Archery
Club: Literature Studies
Likes: People that understand his countries History, Culture, and Fashion
Dislikes: Things that aren't Poetic
Image Color: Violet

From a Japanese noble family. His father sent him studying abroad because he was anxious about the future of the country and wanted his son to know of the wider world.
But there might be some other reason as well that he isn't aware of.
